item.description: For the most part, PGN has not changed much in 50 years. Front-page news stories, arts and entertainment spreads, editorials, special features. item.title: Taking the community seriously: A history of advertising in PGN
item.description: As one might expect from a local community newspaper, advertisers for Philadelphia Gay News’ very first issue in January 1976 were composed primarily of local community businesses: Roscoe’s, DCA Disco, Astral Plane, Hasty-Tasty Deli, The Steps.
